events.name: The Shedinja Question
events.intro:
In the grass ahead, a wild Nincada splits its back, climbs out as a Ninjask, and buzzes away over the trees.

Its shell stays where it was. Hollow, light, perfectly still. Then the shell gets up.

*It turns. Nothing else is here. It follows the player because the player is something.*

success.text: It floats a little behind you, close enough that you can hear nothing at all. You walk on, and it comes, and neither of you says why.

events.name: The Shedinja Question: The Rest

remembers.notice: *It is waiting at the edge of the light, exactly where it hovered last time. It hasn't forgotten the question.*

events.intro:
The fire is low. The shell drifts in from the dark, and hovers in front of one of the party. And holds still.

*It's waiting to be told what it is.*

success.text: You look at your team. One of them lifts its head.

effects.text: *It settles into the party as if it had always been there. Nobody asks it what it is. It seems to like that.*
*One morning the light is only light. The shell is not at the edge of it. The grass where it hovered is pressed flat, and slowly, it stands up again.*

success.text: You sit up. It turns, slowly, to face you.
Nobody does. The shell stays a long moment, then drifts back to the edge of the light.

effects.text: *It settles into the party as if it had always been there. Nobody asks it what it is. It seems to like that.*
*One morning the light is only light. The shell is not at the edge of it. The grass where it hovered is pressed flat, and slowly, it stands up again.*

success.text: You think of the one that flew. You tell it you will look. The shell turns, towards the dark, and waits.

events.name: The Shedinja Question: Your Answer
events.intro:
It hasn't moved. You are the one it is hovering in front of. The fire pops. The shell does not.

Whatever you say, it will believe.

success.text: Something in the way it hangs changes. It drifts closer, until it is nearly touching your sleeve.

effects.text: *It settles into the party as if it had always been there. Nobody asks it what it is. It seems to like that.*
*One morning the light is only light. The shell is not at the edge of it. The grass where it hovered is pressed flat, and slowly, it stands up again.*

success.text: It is quiet. It stays exactly as it was, because it has no other way to stay.

effects.text: *It settles into the party as if it had always been there. Nobody asks it what it is. It seems to like that.*
*One morning the light is only light. The shell is not at the edge of it. The grass where it hovered is pressed flat, and slowly, it stands up again.*

success.text: You say it to the fire, and then to it. It tips towards you, very slightly. Nobody knew anything, and now two of you don't.

*One morning the light is only light. The shell is not at the edge of it. The grass where it hovered is pressed flat, and slowly, it stands up again.*

events.name: The Shedinja Question: The Ninjask
events.intro:
A Ninjask hums over the grass, fast, bright, and gone before you can see it properly.

*The Ninjask zips past it twice. Neither knows the other. The Shedinja watches it go, and turns back to the player.*

success.text: It watches the sky a moment longer. Then it comes back to your side. It chose, in its way.
